Why These Matter

Quantum sensing technologies exploit quantum effects (like superposition and entanglement) to achieve unprecedented sensitivity in measuring physical quantities such as magnetic and electric fields, time, gravity, and motion. These sensors have applications in defense, aerospace, navigation, geophysics, medical imaging, and fundamental science — with commercial adoption projected to grow rapidly through the 2030s.
